██████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████
  ENGLISH
██████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████

WHAT YOU NEED:
  - A Windows computer (Windows 10 or newer)
  - Google Chrome browser installed
  - The WhatsApp account logged in on your phone (for QR scan)

HOW TO INSTALL (2 steps):

  Step 1 — Double-click the file named "install.bat"

  Step 2 — If Chrome is open, close ALL Chrome windows, then
           press ENTER in the black window that appears.

  That's it! Open Chrome normally — the extension is ready.

  If you don't see the green dot icon in the toolbar:
    - Click the puzzle icon 🧩 (Extensions) in Chrome's top-right
    - Find "WA Chat Exporter" and click the pin 📌 icon


HOW TO UNINSTALL:

  Step 1 — Double-click the file named "uninstall.bat"
  Step 2 — Close Chrome, reopen — the extension is removed


QUESTIONS?
  Contact your IT team or supervisor for help.


██████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████
  BAHASA INDONESIA
██████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████

YANG DIBUTUHKAN:
  - Komputer Windows (Windows 10 atau lebih baru)
  - Google Chrome sudah terpasang
  - Akun WhatsApp sudah login di ponsel Anda (untuk pindai QR)

CARA INSTAL (2 langkah):

  Langkah 1 — Klik dua kali file bernama "install.bat"

  Langkah 2 — Jika Chrome sedang terbuka, TUTUP SEMUA jendela
              Chrome, lalu tekan ENTER di jendela hitam yang muncul.

  Selesai! Buka Chrome seperti biasa — ekstensi sudah siap.

  Jika ikon bulat hijau tidak muncul di toolbar:
    - Klik ikon puzzle 🧩 (Extensions) di kanan atas Chrome
    - Cari "WA Chat Exporter" dan klik pin 📌


CARA MENGHAPUS:

  Langkah 1 — Klik dua kali file bernama "uninstall.bat"
  Langkah 2 — Tutup Chrome, buka kembali — ekstensi terhapus


PERTANYAAN?
  Hubungi tim IT atau supervisor Anda untuk bantuan.
